b: The Berlin venue's head of sales, Tjabo Reuter, has described it as "a serious error of judgement"

Kraftwerk Berlin, the venue that hosts Berlin Atonal and houses clubs such as Tresor and OHM within its complex, has apologied after it hosted an event for German defence technology company Helsing last week.

The event on 11 November saw Helsing launch Clarity, its new AI-supported military intelligence platform, in Kraftwerk's main Turbine Hall. Helsing has hit the headlines in recent years after Spotify co-founder and former CEO Daniel Ek emerged as a key investor in the business.
